incidents.what: The maintenance workflow's backup-db job (nightly 03:17 UTC, the production DB backup to the R2 blob tier) has failed EVERY run since it was introduced: runs 35580701817 (2026-09-21, 04d8820), 35705502209 (2026-09-22, 40327bc) and 35838057275 (2026-09-23, main @a997aab) — all with the 'Run nexus maintenance backup' step exiting 1. Since 09-21 the backup path code (maintenance/backup.py, storage/providers/r2.py) is unchanged, so the failure is environmental: either the R2 secrets are not configured (by-design red, 'fail loudly'), or the R2+Neon combination is misconfigured. The exact error text is UNVERIFIED from this sandbox (Actions log download EOFs here). Consequence: no production database backup has ever been produced by this pipeline.
incidents.resolution: Owner action required: read the failed job log (any of the three runs), set/verify the R2_* and NEXUS_DATABASE_URL repo secrets per docs/ops/r2-storage.md §4, then trigger a manual run (workflow_dispatch) and confirm an upload under backups/db/<stamp>/. Tracked as task-164 (next_work). NOTE: if NEXUS_DATABASE_URL is unset in CI the job can never back up real data — the runner has no local SQLite file (settings default data/app.sqlite does not exist there), so the documented 'local SQLite fallback' is only meaningful on a host that actually runs the bot.
